    Class TransformFeatureHandler

    Named transformFeature handler. Modal (enable()→setEditMode ('transform')). On pointerdown over an already-selected feature it opens the matching editSession (selection itself is delegated to the modifier-aware clickSelect/boxSelect); pointermove streams the per-frame delta (translate dx/dy, or rotate/scale matrix vs the session origin); pointerup commits (one undo entry); Escape cancels. Absorbs the boilerplate previously hand-wired in the transform examples.

    Example

    Runnable example association: box-select, feature-rotate-scale, feature-selection.

    getCursor

    • getCursor(): string | null

      CSS cursor this handler wants for its CURRENT state, or null = no opinion (HandlerManager falls through to lower-priority handlers, then the page/CSS default). Optional — absent ⇒ no opinion. An empty string '' is treated the same as null (no opinion); to clear to the page/CSS default, simply have no enabled handler with an opinion (HandlerManager writes '' itself in that case).
